title: Remove Admin Accounts tab and manage user accounts from Orders

requirements.text: Remove the standalone “Accounts” area from the Admin Panel UI (including its tab trigger, tab content, and any related lazy imports) so admins no longer manage accounts from a separate Admin Accounts section.

quotes: Ok yes remove the accounts area in the admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel no longer shows an “Accounts” tab/section.
No unused/lazy imports remain for the removed Accounts section (e.g., AdminAccountsSection).
Admin Panel header/description text is updated so it does not claim admins manage accounts from the dashboard if the accounts area was removed.

requirements.text: Add account management controls to admin order management so an admin can ban/unban and manage VIP status for the account tied to an order directly from the order UI.

quotes: make me be able to ban and manage people accounts from there order so if they place a order i can manage there account from the order

acceptanceCriteria: For any order that has an owner principal, the admin UI exposes controls to: (1) ban/unban the owner, and (2) grant/revoke VIP for the owner, without navigating to a separate Accounts page.
If an order has no owner (owner is null), the UI clearly indicates that account management is unavailable for that order and does not show broken controls.
After a ban/unban or VIP change, the UI refreshes to reflect the updated account status and does not require a manual page reload.
User-facing text for these controls and confirmations is in English.

requirements.text: Provide a backend API to fetch account status for a specific principal (used by the order-linked account management UI) without requiring loading the entire accounts list.

quotes: ban and manage people accounts from there order

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only query method to fetch account info for a given Principal (including at least: isBanned, isVIP, profile if present, and orderCount).
The method traps with an authorization error when called by a non-admin.
Frontend order-linked account management UI uses this targeted API (or an equivalent targeted mechanism) to display current status for the order owner.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose those components instead.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity only).
Do not add promo-code backend functionality or other unrelated admin features.
Do not implement bulk account actions beyond per-order/per-owner management.
